$comment: The label taxonomy of K-WORK-12 (rulebook/01-work-items.md) in a form code can read. The table is the rule and this file its machine-readable twin: tests/unit/labels.test.ts fails when the two disagree, and when a lane, script or prompt in the library applies a label that is not here (K-PRIN-2). scripts/lib/labels.mjs reads it to create a label a lane is about to apply and the repository lacks, with this colour and description; a name that is not here is never created. `project:<n>` is a template a lane fills in; an entry with `createdBy` is never created by a lane. Change the table and this file in the same commit.

labels.name: agent:explorer
labels.description: Filed by the Explorer

labels.name: agent:triage
labels.description: Dispatches the Implementer's bug-fix lane

labels.name: agent:implement
labels.description: Dispatches the Implementer's build lane; marks the PRs it opens

labels.name: agent:reviewer
labels.description: Filed or reviewed by the Reviewer

labels.name: agent:overseer
labels.description: Filed by the Overseer

labels.name: agent:revise
labels.description: Re-delivers a lost review to the Implementer's revise lane; applied by the Lead only

labels.name: agent:lead-revise
labels.description: Re-delivers a lost review to the Lead's brief-revise lane; applied by the Lead only

labels.name: qa:needs-triage
labels.description: Bug filed, awaiting the Implementer's triage

labels.name: qa:reproduced
labels.description: Independently reproduced: confirmed real

labels.name: qa:cannot-reproduce
labels.description: The Implementer could not reproduce it

labels.name: qa:false-positive
labels.description: Not a real bug (feeds precision metrics)

labels.name: qa:fix-proposed
labels.description: A fix PR is open and linked

labels.name: qa:needs-info
labels.description: A human owes an answer or parked the issue; parks its project and its implement lane

labels.name: qa:needs-severity
labels.description: Reviewer follow-up filed with no severity; the filer must set one

labels.name: qa:needs-split
labels.description: Implementer run hit its cap; the Lead proposes a split; never dispatched

labels.name: qa:human-action
labels.description: Project item a human must do (not a PR); never dispatched, does not park the project

labels.name: qa:verify
labels.description: Project verification issue: the Explorer verifies the project's acceptance criteria

labels.name: sev:critical
labels.description: Data loss, a security or isolation breach, or an outage

labels.name: sev:high
labels.description: Core flow broken, no workaround

labels.name: sev:medium
labels.description: Flow degraded, workaround exists

labels.name: sev:low
labels.description: Cosmetic or minor

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request; also a product project's tracking issue

labels.name: spec-delta
labels.description: Proposed behavioural invariant (the Explorer's second output)

labels.name: follow-up
labels.description: Deferred work captured from a review or audit

labels.name: pipeline-improvement
labels.description: Improvement to the pipeline itself; also a platform project's tracking issue

labels.name: capability
labels.description: Capability investigation: the cohort the Overseer's interlock counts

labels.name: signal:spec-violation
labels.description: Contradicts a promoted behavioural invariant

labels.name: signal:<name>
labels.description: One per objective signal on the project's list (K-AGENT-9); b60205 for a security signal
labels.createdBy: the project's signal list (K-AGENT-9), never a lane

labels.name: review:please
labels.description: Asks the Reviewer to review this PR

labels.name: gate-candidate
labels.description: Filer says launch-gating (sev:critical or sev:high); the Stakeholder decides if it joins the gate

labels.name: gate:declined
labels.description: The Stakeholder declined this gate-candidate for the gate; applied by a person only

labels.name: needs:human
labels.description: A human decides: the Merger declined this PR, or the Lead held this project

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on something outside the pipeline; parks the issue's whole project

labels.name: project:<n>
labels.description: Project #n: mirrors the project marker; written by the Lead only

labels.name: from-app
labels.description: Filed from the running application; never dispatched

labels.name: autorelease: pending
labels.description: Created and applied by the Releaser only
labels.createdBy: the release tool, never a lane

labels.name: autorelease: tagged
labels.description: Created and applied by the Releaser only
labels.createdBy: the release tool, never a lane
